description: Baitly illustrative room scenes, transparent alpha outside the architecture. Opening variants follow reported contact states. Original generated PNGs are retained.
transparencyPrompt: Background extraction edit only. Remove the entire pale blue background OUTSIDE this isometric dollhouse room and replace it with genuinely transparent alpha. Preserve the full room including floor slab, ALL walls, windows, door, furniture, plants and every interior detail exactly. Preserve original dimensions, framing, camera angle, geometry, lighting, object positions, opening states, materials and colors. Clean anti-aliased silhouette edge. No blue/white matte fringe. Exterior cast shadows may remain softly translucent. DO NOT remove walls, the floor or ceiling edges. DO NOT change anything within the room. Output a PNG with true transparency, not a checkerboard or white background.

assets.prompt:

assets.revisionPrompt: Edit this Baitly isometric room illustration for an interactive smart-home configurator. Preserve the same room identity, furniture, number and type of beds where present, oak/cream/navy materials, lighting, dollhouse perspective and 4:3 framing. Recompose only as needed to make mounting space genuinely available: taller visible walls with a broad empty upper-left wall strip suitable for a wall-mounted split AC; a clearly visible closed wooden interior entry door along the far-left edge of the left wall, with room around its handle and frame; retain an unobstructed window with visible frame on the right wall. Remove framed paintings/decorative wall art that occupy those mounting spaces. Leave multiple distinct clear wall patches for small sensor overlays, away from the furniture, mirrors, curtains and window; keep the center-upper rear corner clear for a ceiling sensor overlay. Add ONE simple unlit frosted wall sconce on a clear area above the door for a smart light overlay. DO NOT add any smart device, split unit, sensors, camera, label, marker, wiring, numbers or text. These will be overlaid separately in software. All furniture remains complete and naturally placed. Keep a pale blue opaque background matching #e8f0f5, not transparent. Full room should fit with a small 3 percent margin; high-quality warm photorealistic 3D, consistent across the set.
